summary: Talos Energy Inc. disclosed via Form 8-K (Items 7.01 and 8.01) that its wholly owned subsidiary, Talos Production Inc., commenced an $800 million private offering of second-priority senior secured notes due 2034. Proceeds will partly fund the pending acquisition of oil and gas properties in the Mississippi Canyon area of the Gulf of America, including interests in Na Kika and Coulomb deepwater assets. The offering is exempt from SEC registration and includes a preliminary offering memorandum furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No specific price per share, premium, or board recommendation was provided; the notes offering supports a broader acquisition.
